question: Infosys SP / DSE on-campus interview (HackWithInfy track). Reported questions in this round across candidates: **implement any two kinds of constructors** and **explain how garbage collection works**, along with other OOP and cloud-computing questions. Candidates were also told to be ready to defend every keyword on their resume.
lookingFor: Knowing constructor types and when each is used.
Ability to write correct code for them.
Understanding of automatic memory management and reachability.
Knowing what the programmer can and cannot control.
Awareness of memory leaks even with garbage collection.
followUps: What is the difference between a constructor and a method?
Can a constructor be private, and when is that useful?
What is the difference between stack and heap memory in Java?
How would you find a memory leak in a Java application?
